subject: 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway Life Science Proposal
overview: The board conducted a site plan review discussion regarding a proposed eight-story life science building at 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway, currently the site of Bertucci's. After hearing details on building massing, traffic impacts, environmental mitigation, and variances, the board continued the hearing to June 9, 2022.

items.title: Site plan review recommendations for 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: RISE Together and the design team presented a proposal for an eight-story, approximately 300,000-square-foot life science facility with three levels of below-grade parking, ground-floor community and retail space, and public plaza improvements. Board members questioned the requested zoning variances, building width, massing, stormwater handling near wetlands, and traffic impacts on Mystic Valley Parkway before voting to continue the hearing to June 9, 2022.

items.title: Miscellaneous staff and board updates
items.summary: Staff and board members discussed the rescheduled Great American Beer Hall community meeting, Comprehensive Plan outreach, draft MBTA bus network redesign proposals, and board vacancies and reappointments.
